article.title: The travails of being mineral-rich
article.author: Prabhat Patnaik
article.content: If some particular mineral of commercial use is found in a country of the global South, then multinational corporations from the North descend upon that country to extract this mineral wealth. The post The travails of being mineral-rich appeared first on MR Online .
